description: This PHP file defines a web form interface for searching test cases in the TestLink project. It includes functions for initializing search arguments and GUI elements, and generates a search form using Smarty templates.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: A class managing test project data, used to retrieve test case prefixes and keywords.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and returns an object containing test project ID and name from session data, throws an exception if test project ID is invalid.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Builds and returns a GUI object with various search criteria settings related to a specific test project.
